name: Ben 10 (Omnitrix)
title: Master of the Omnitrix & Hero of 10 Aliens

attacks.name: Omnitrix Alien Morph & Slam
attacks.description: Slams the emerald Omnitrix dial, transforming into Heatblast, Four Arms, XLR8, or Diamondhead with an explosive alien blast.

attacks.name: Heatblast Magma Fireball
attacks.description: Pyronite alien Heatblast projects molten volcanic fireballs that incinerate web images and cards into glowing embers.

attacks.name: Four Arms Thunderclap Shockwave
attacks.description: Tetramand red titan Four Arms slams all 4 muscular fists together in a massive sonic shockwave pulverizing paragraphs.

attacks.name: XLR8 Supersonic Cyclone Strike
attacks.description: Kineceleran speedster XLR8 dashes on frictionless wheel-feet at Mach 5, creating razor-sharp supersonic slipstreams.

attacks.name: Diamondhead Crystal Shard Barrage
attacks.description: Petrosapien crystalline warrior Diamondhead fires sharp diamond crystal shard volleys that lodge and shatter DOM elements.

voicelines: Let's see what the Omnitrix has dialed in!
Heatblast! Ready to bring the heat!
Four Arms is in the house! Time to clobber!
Too fast for you! XLR8 can't be caught!
